narration: Most people think they've done everything right — maxed their 401k, maxed their Roth IRA. But there's a third door nobody told you about, and it's worth $43,500 a year.
visual: Person silhouette stands before three doors labeled 401K, ROTH IRA, and ??? — the third door glows blue and pulses. '$43,500/YEAR' text reveals at the end.

narration: Here's what everyone knows: $23,000 into your 401k, $7,000 into a Roth IRA. Thirty grand total, right? There's actually a $46,000 gap your plan is hiding from you.
visual: Two animated piggy banks side by side — one labeled 401K with $23,000 counting up, one labeled ROTH IRA with $7,000. Total '= $30,000 MAX?' appears, then 'NOT EVEN CLOSE' in red.

narration: Your 401k has a total annual limit of $69,000 — not $23,000. The difference is a $46,000 after-tax contribution gap your employer already set aside, and almost nobody uses it.
visual: Horizontal progress bar splits into two segments: '$23K YOURS' in grey and '$46K THE GAP' in blue animating in from left. Label 'TOTAL LIMIT: $69,000' appears below.

narration: Here's the move: you contribute after-tax dollars to fill that gap, then immediately convert them to Roth. It's called the Mega Backdoor Roth — the IRS says it's completely legal.
visual: Two buckets: 'AFTER-TAX 401K' (grey) and 'ROTH TAX-FREE' (blue). Arrow animates between them with coins flying across. Green '100% LEGAL' stamp springs in.

narration: That move lets you add up to $43,500 of Roth money every single year — six times the regular Roth limit. Over 30 years, that compounds into over four million dollars, completely tax-free.
visual: Counter animates from $0 up to $43,500 in blue. Calendar pages cycle as years pass. '$4,000,000+' springs in large with 'TAX-FREE GROWTH' label.

narration: About 20% of 401k plans allow this right now. Open your plan documents today and search for 'after-tax contributions' or 'in-plan Roth conversion.' If it's there, you've been leaving a fortune behind.
visual: Phone SVG showing a search screen typing 'after-tax contributions' with plan document results. 'CHECK TODAY' button springs in. 'MEGA BACKDOOR ROTH' title at top.
